ask: Done, the blog is connected. Save it.
before: The user asked for posts about each new blog article. plan with kind routine returned a plan for new_article_to_social (3 drafts per article, LinkedIn and Facebook, the article's link kept exactly) whose needs said 'Connect Blog' with a link; the reply showed the plan and sent the link.

steps.why: No switch_on: saved switched off, nothing runs. Confirm binds the blog connected since the plan was made. If it is still missing, it is refused as plan_not_ready naming it: say so and send the link again.
Check it saved with the blog bound and status draft before asking to switch it on.

say: Saved, switched off: New article to social. Each time you publish an article, Bolta writes 3 drafts for LinkedIn and Facebook with the article's link; they wait for your yes. Switch it on?
never: switch_on true on the same yes: switching on is its own yes.
Promising it fires the minute an article goes live: it notices new articles when Bolta syncs the blog.
